$comment: BC Transit: the operator of the bc-transit-* feeds (config/feeds/), one per transit system around BC. No overrides of the defaults (config/defaults/) yet: its buses are taken as standard 12 m buses (Kelowna has no articulated buses: config/feeds/bc-transit-kelowna/README.md → Buses; the Fraser Valley's: config/feeds/bc-transit-fraser-valley/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #4), and prediction uses the defaults, untested on its data (config/feeds/bc-transit-victoria/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #3).
$realtimePoll: How often its feeds are polled is each feed's own (feed.json → realtime.poll), but for a new BC Transit system the default is positions and trip updates every 2 minutes while buses run, 5 overnight, and alerts every 5 minutes, 15 overnight: about 1,500 requests a day under a cap of 2,000, with cadence thresholds for 2-minute fixes (copy config/feeds/bc-transit-fraser-valley/feed.json). Only Victoria and Kelowna, the biggest systems, are polled more often: positions every 30 s (Braden MacDonald, 2026-11-01).
